items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: Chubby Jackson was the cheerleader... And whatever he would do on the stand, Sonny Gorman would try to emulate.

ctx.x: MR. HERMAN: And some of them were characters. Chubby Jackson was the cheerleader and the ringleader of much of what happened visually in the band and on the stage and so on. He was like the spark plug and could really turn it on. He was
the cheerleader. And whatever he would do on the stand, Sonny Gorman would try to emulate.
